propositions: FAIL remediation guidance states that ticket-comment evidence will be considered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required for external operator-attested evidence.

Untagged external criteria are classified as codebase-verifiable by ADR 0043 and cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone, causing correct FAIL verdicts that contradict incomplete remediation wording.

The remediation guidance must distinguish between repository-verifiable evidence and external operator-attested evidence by naming the exact tag prerequisite and explaining the untagged external limitation.
Strengthened interface test requires [operator-attested] tag, external/repository distinction, and the contract that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.
The guidance must remain generic and not advertise force/bypass, preserving existing completion-verdict semantics.
